summary: Fresh-install lab harness fixes for the second Phase 2 gate run: Controller appliance provenance reads the nex-core-local package for --expected-version instead of a hard-coded 0.1.0+managed1 path, console typing helper sends Shift as its own key event, and a new interrupt-delete recovery stage (not yet run in a lab) kills nex-core-local at the wiping or cleaning-nvram journal stage of one named disposable guest and requires succeeded or needs_attention with a reason after restart; the record marks killed_while_pending, since only a pending kill is interrupted-operation evidence, and --hold is limited to wiping, where it makes the wipe fail before the kill (failed-wipe restart evidence). API impact: none; test harness only.

guide.reason: Only contributor lab harnesses changed; no operator workflow, product behavior or message changed.

api.reason: API impact: none. The harness reads the existing host journal and systemd unit over SSH in a disposable lab and calls no new or changed Controller or Core API.

roadmap.reason: Gate evidence tooling only; interrupted-delete lab evidence (P2-4b, P2-4c) stays outstanding until the new stage is run.

state.reason: Test harness only; it writes evidence files to an operator-selected directory and keeps no product state.

verification.method: Unit checks only: python3 -m unittest tests.test_fresh_install_host tests.test_fresh_install_recovery tests.test_fresh_install_lab tests.test_fresh_install_gate_guest. The provenance and interrupt-delete lab stages were not run against a disposable lab in this change.
